source='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x), (y+1,x), (y,x-1), (y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells); r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells); c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            height, width = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
            if height < 3 or width < 3:
                continue
            if not all(grid[r0][x] == color and grid[r1][x] == color for x in range(c0, c1+1)):
                continue
            if not all(grid[y][c0] == color and grid[y][c1] == color for y in range(r0, r1+1)):
                continue
            if any(grid[y][x] != background for y in range(r0+1, r1) for x in range(c0+1, c1)):
                continue
            fill = 7 if height % 2 == 1 and width % 2 == 1 else 2
            for y in range(r0+1, r1):
                for x in range(c0+1, c1):
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
